claim_label: approximate reproduction; exploratory TEST comparison and compute estimate

scientific_choices.choice: Reuse completed three-dataset GPU transfer readings and Total-Text direct original640 YOLO boxes/PARSeq readings. Do not use high-resolution, tiled or crop-variant branches. Preserve local normalized bbox matching and ignore policy.

Total-Text stored recognition is CPU FP32; the other three completed recognition runs are RTX3090 FP32. Preserve and report each source device. New read-only forward profiling uses CPU FP32 and sequential model residency; it does not qualify GPU latency or memory.

Total-Text reuses the same 95-point scalar confidence controls as the previous suite. All maxima are exploratory TEST selections; seek shared joint threshold improvement without silently changing deployment settings.

Count dense convolution/linear MACs, full MultiheadAttention projections and QK/AV products, plus ViT QK/AV products; use two floating-point operations per MAC. Exclude biases, activations, normalization, softmax, embeddings, decode comparisons, preprocessing and NMS. This is a dominant-arithmetic FLOP estimate, not a complete operator count.

Profile the qualified checkpoints and unmodified autoregressive/refine1 PARSeq forward. Use recorded YOLO tensor shapes; Total-Text shapes are derived from qualified single-image Ultralytics8.1.0 auto LetterBox at640/stride32 and checked against the other datasets.

Choose four evenly spaced images per dataset by frozen sample order, without GT. Profile all their original crops using stored per-image batch32 ordering. Estimate dataset mean recognition compute from all-image crop density times the sampled per-crop compute; retain sampling ranges and CPU/cached output differences.

A separate full26-step PARSeq profile is a conservative counted-arithmetic budget; it is not the deployed early-EOS execution or an accuracy run. Safe pre-OCR filtering budgets are hypothetical and need batch-reexecution qualification.

Exact GPU conditional decoding FLOPs for every crop, full non-MAC operation counting, official polygon Hmean and paper Table4 profiler compatibility remain unresolved. CTW1500 is still full-line evaluation.
